item.title: Cost of Living in Endeavour Hills Melbourne
item.description:
Money matters when you’re choosing where to live. Here’s the real story on costs in Endeavour Hills — no sugar-coating, no made-up figures.

Read our full Endeavour Hills suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Endeavour Hills Expensive?

Endeavour Hills sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Endeavour Hills, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Endeavour Hills — History and How It's Changed
item.description:

What Endeavour Hills Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Endeavour Hills was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.
